description: Google’s indexing reasons for 100 known URLs a run in a fixed order (lost-click pages, Search Console pages by clicks then impressions, sitemap URLs, then the rest), each checked live and labelled fix, check, expected or indexed from the evidence, sorted by reason then URL. Use it for a first baseline and then weekly: keep the full result and compare by URL and reason to find new reasons. Also: Pages that had at least 3 clicks in the previous 28 days and kept 20% or less of them in the last 28 days, with a live check of the top 20 and Google’s index status for the top 10 and the home page.

detail.description: summary first. rows: the next page of rows. full: every field as JSON.

max_urls.description: URLs to inspect with Google, 100 by default, up to the URL Inspection quota left today.

offset.description: rows only: the first row to return.

site.description: Search Console property or site, such as sc-domain:example.com, https://example.com/ or example.com.

name: seo_index
title: Google indexing reasons and pages that lost their clicks
